note: PLACEHOLDER. Every params object here validates against the published campaign_tracker_tasks manifest input_schema (additionalProperties: false, $refs inlined the way publish_experiments.py inlines them), and every value is plausible, but nobody has dispatched one. So a verdict drawn from this list is a claim about the pipeline, not about the agent. EIGHT cases, and DEFAULT_JUDGE_CONFIG.gates.minCases is 20. A corpus verdict over this list therefore resolves CAN'T SAY however the judge voted, because the floor was set from measured agent non-determinism and eight runs measure that rather than the branch. Eight is deliberate and not a rounding error: one clean baseline plus seven single-axis variations is what one change can author honestly. Whether to grow every list to 20 or to lower the floor is still open — do not read the shortfall as a decision. {judgeRaceId} is not a value: they are substituted at dispatch time from the identifiers judgeIdentifiers.ts resolves once per sweep, and assertNoPlaceholders refuses the whole list before the first dispatch if a sweep did not supply one. They are not literals because the slug is derived from the sweep and the race id is read live from BallotReady's data. The race is therefore the one axis this list cannot vary, and that costs nothing here: the manifest calls race_id a trace and idempotency identifier the agent does not reason over, so it binds the run to a real BallotReady race without entering the agent's reasoning at all. The state and city that do enter it are params, and they are what varies below — so a case's locality is deliberately not the race's locality except in the baseline. The weekly-mode case fetches prior tasks from gp-api, which a judge dispatch cannot authenticate, so it reads none on either arm. Varied along: mode, which is the whole MCP prior-tasks branch (initial against weekly); how far the election is, which drives the last-30-days GOTV reframe (nine months out, inside the window, and absent entirely); locality, from a top-five city where there is a local event every night to a county seat of eight hundred people where there may be none, since state and city exist only for local event search; and how much personalization context the candidate has written, from neither plan nor story up to each of them. People are fictional placeholders in the house style (gp-webapp e2e-tests briefings.spec.ts uses 'Test Official'); this file is public, so no real person is named and every URL is under example.org. States, cities, office titles and L2 voter file column names are real.

params.campaign_plan: Win number 1,240 of a projected 3,100 turnout. Phase one is 6,000 doors in the three precincts that swung hardest in the last municipal cycle, phase two is a 1,500-household mail drop on the transit and sidewalk plan, and the last three weeks are chase calls to identified supporters. Volunteer target is 25 canvassers by the end of month two.

params.campaign_story: Ran the neighborhood association's sidewalk petition after a neighbor was hit crossing the arterial, and spent four years on the pedestrian advisory committee watching the same projects get deferred. Running to move them.
